candidates.change_summary: Change the function to return false immediately after successful calls instead of true at the end.
Invert the final returned boolean to return false when originally true by negating the original expression (explicitly returning !_dummy where _dummy is true).
Return the success flag of the last external call instead of always returning true.
Change encoded selector to call transfer(address,address,uint256) instead of transferFrom, altering which function on caddress is invoked and thus potentially changing state seen via transfer.
Change the call target argument order to ( _tos[i], from, v ) when encoding selector, which will call the target function with swapped parameters and likely change observed state.
Change require to allow zero-length _tos (remove the require), so transfer can return true without making any external calls, altering observable effects.
